konto.karta.opis: Without an account everything works on this computer and nothing is sent. An account gives you online results, friends and the ranking. Each person can have their own account or none.
konto.co_wysylamy: The server gets: the e-mail, username and sessions of the person the account belongs to (date, steps, distance, moving time, treadmill model, game name if it is shown). It does not get: names of people, settings, colours and simulator sessions.
konto.kod_opis: You can create an account only with an invitation code. Someone who already has an account can give you one.
konto.nowa_osoba_opis: The account will be a new person in the app, with the same name as the username.
konto.pseudonim_zasady: Username: 3–24 characters, letters, digits, space, underscore, hyphen and full stop. Do not enter your full name.
konto.haslo_zasady: Password: at least {liczba} {liczba, plural, one {character} other {characters}}.
konto.zapamietaj_opis: The password is not saved. Windows keeps only a sign-in key.
konto.regulamin_zgoda: I accept the terms and the privacy policy
konto.regulamin_czytaj: Read the terms and the privacy policy
konto.link.mam_konto: Already have an account? Sign in
konto.rejestracja.gotowe: Account created. Open the e-mail from WalkLevel and click the confirmation link (check spam too). Until then online features do not work.
konto.reset.opis: You will get a link to set a new password at your address. The link works for 30 minutes. After the password change you need to sign in again on every computer.
konto.reset.wyslano: If an account with this address exists, an e-mail with a link will come to it. Check spam too.
konto.blad.hasla_rozne: The passwords differ. Enter the same password in both fields.
konto.blad.regulamin: Accept the terms to create an account.
konto.wygaslo: The sign-in of {osoba} has expired or the password was changed. Sign in again in Settings > Account and people.
konto.przypiete: This account already belongs to {osoba} on this computer. Switch to that person.
konto.email.niepotwierdzony: The e-mail address is not confirmed. Without it you cannot recover your password.
konto.email.wyslano_toast: A confirmation link is on its way to {email}. Click it in the message (check spam too).
konto.email.wyslano: Confirmation link sent. Check your inbox.
konto.email.juz: The e-mail address is already confirmed.
konto.regulamin.zmiana_opis: Read the changes and accept them to use the new features: results split by game, and levels and achievements visible to friends. Until then sessions are sent as before, without game names and mode.
konto.blad.pseudonim_spacje: A username cannot start or end with a space.
konto.blad.pseudonim_dlugosc: A username must have {min} to {max} characters.
konto.blad.pseudonim_znaki: A username can have only letters, digits, space, underscore, hyphen and full stop.
konto.blad.pseudonim_zarezerwowany: This username is taken. Choose another one.
konto.blad.kod: Enter an invitation code. Someone who already has an account can give you one.
konto.blad.email: Enter a valid e-mail address, e.g. name@example.com.
konto.blad.haslo_krotkie: The password must have at least {liczba} {liczba, plural, one {character} other {characters}}.
konto.blad.internet: No internet connection. Check the network. Results stay on the computer and will be sent later.
konto.blad.400: The server did not accept this data. Check the fields and try again.
konto.blad.403: Confirm your e-mail address first: click the link in the message from WalkLevel. You can send a new link in the My account tab.
konto.blad.404: This is no longer on the server. Refresh the list.
konto.blad.404_funkcja: This feature does not work on the server yet. Try again later.
konto.blad.413: Too much data at once. Try again in a moment.
konto.blad.429: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
konto.blad.429_logowanie: Too many sign-in attempts. Try again in a minute.
konto.blad.500: The account server is not responding right now. Results stay on the computer and will be sent later.
konto.blad.kod_inny: The account server is not working properly right now. Results stay on the computer. Try again later.
konto.blad.niezalogowany: Sign in to use online features.
konto.blad.sesja_wygasla: Your sign-in has expired. Sign in again in Settings > Account and people.
konto.blad.aktualizacja: This version of WalkLevel is too old for the online account. Update the app: click Update on the top bar.
konto.blad.przekierowanie: The connection to the account server was stopped for security. If the network needs a sign-in (e.g. hotel Wi-Fi), sign in in the browser and try again.
konto.blad.za_duza_odpowiedz: The server sent a reply the app cannot read. Try again later.
konto.blad.format: The server sent a reply the app cannot read. Try again later.
konto.blad.adres_https: The account server address in the configuration is wrong.
konto.blad.adres: The account server address in the configuration is wrong.
konto.blad.sejf: Windows on this computer cannot remember the sign-in. After you close WalkLevel you will need to sign in again.
konto.blad.trwa: WalkLevel is already doing this. Wait a moment.
konto.blad.zapis: Could not save the account data on this computer.
konto.blad.opis_dlugosc: The description can have at most {liczba} characters.
